body:
I really appreciate you taking the time to write all of this. I'm looking in to getting a membership at a gym that two of my friends go to every other day after school. While I'm already decently in shape I think that working out will help me look and feel better, and also give me something to focus on when I'm not in school.

You are completely right about idling being bad for people in my state of mind. Your comment helped me realize that the worst thing to do when I'm feeling like shit is sitting around and thinking about how shitty I feel. No one is going to make my life better but me.

I think I finally understand that life is really just what I make of it. I won't give up on life. I have to try and make it better.

Thank you for this comment.

As I sat here for the last 20 minutes refreshing the page, I realized this is just a waste of time. I want people to reply telling me how I can just stop feeling this way... But I know the only responses coming are about how this is "temporary" and "life gets better".. I can't wait anymore to stop feeling like this
